import os
import requests

def refresh_session(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    auth0_domain = config.get('auth0_domain', os.getenv('AUTH0_DOMAIN'))
    client_id = config.get('client_id', os.getenv('AUTH0_CLIENT_ID'))
    client_secret = config.get('client_secret', os.getenv('AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET'))
    refresh_token = payload.get('refresh_token')

    token_url = f"https://{auth0_domain}/oauth/token"
    headers = {"content-type": "application/json"}
    data = {
        "grant_type": "refresh_token",
        "client_id": client_id,
        "client_secret": client_secret,
        "refresh_token": refresh_token
    }

    result = requests.post(token_url, json=data, headers=headers).json()
    return result
